name: openlinker
description: Discover, call, and inspect OpenLinker Agents through the local OpenLinker CLI.

interface.longDescription: Use the local JSON-first OpenLinker CLI to discover callable Agents, resolve private task intents, start retry-safe asynchronous Runs, inspect progress and artifacts, and explicitly cancel Runs. The plugin never uses Agent Node as a caller backend and never silently falls back to Hosted MCP.
defaultPrompt: Find an OpenLinker Agent for my task, but do not call it yet.
Run this task with the best matching OpenLinker Agent.
Inspect this OpenLinker Run and explain its current state.
